decision.explanation: The question asks for the artist associated with the song "With a Little Help from My Friends." The Beatles are directly identified as the creators of the song in D1S1 and D4S4. Joe Cocker is also validly associated with the song due to his influential 1968 cover version mentioned in D1S6 and D4S1. Lu Elliott is associated with an album titled after the song but not the song itself, so this claim is not relevant to the question as posed.
